description: One site in depth for a range: visitors per day (or hour for 24h) with the previous period, top referrers, countries and pages, its production deployments, its Core Web Vitals (Speed Insights p75), and, with board, the board's notes dated in the range. One API request.

board.description: A board the site is on (id or name), to include its notes

anyOf.description: A custom window of whole UTC days, 1 to 30 days, ending today at the latest

range.description: 24h, 7d or 30d, or a custom window { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD" } (UTC days, up to 30). Default 7d.

site.description: A site's id (its Vercel project id), from get_board

name: get_site
title: Get a site
